description: Custom kitchens, wardrobes and walk-in closets in Warsaw: designed by DUMSKAYA DESIGN, made at a partner workshop in Poland, delivered and installed.
h1: Custom furniture and kitchens in Warsaw — design, manufacturing, and installation

blocks.text: Custom furniture and kitchens in Warsaw — design, manufacturing, and installation

parts.html: DUMSKAYA DESIGN designs cabinet furniture for apartments, houses, and commercial spaces in Warsaw. Manufacturing and installation are handled by a partner workshop in Poland that we worked with on our own projects while the studio was based in Warsaw. The design, specifications, and quality control remain on our side.

We make kitchens, built-in wardrobes, walk-in closets, entrance hall furniture, TV units, and furniture for bedrooms, home offices, and bathrooms. Every piece is designed for its specific room — based on on-site measurements and taking into account utilities, appliances, and the style of the interior.

blocks.title: Furniture for Warsaw
rows: in Polish złoty, one total including installation

items: Kitchens — straight, L-shaped, U-shaped, with an island, with built-in appliances; fully custom or based on one of the 32 models in our catalog.
Built-in wardrobes up to the ceiling, with hinged or sliding doors.
Walk-in closets and storage systems with lighting.
Entrance halls — cabinets, benches, shoe cabinets, mirrors, and wall panels.
Living room and bedroom furniture — TV units, wall panels, beds, nightstands, dressers.
Furniture for business — reception desks, offices, retail fixtures.
Request. Send us a floor plan, photos, and examples of furniture you like — or choose a kitchen model from our catalog.
Design. We develop the construction drawings, 3D visualization, and material specifications. Measurements are taken by our partner in Warsaw.
Quote. An exact price in Polish złoty, including delivery and installation.
Production and installation. Manufactured in Poland, installed on site, with the appliances built in.

blocks.text: Questions about custom furniture in Warsaw

items.q: Where is the furniture for Warsaw made?
items.a: At a partner workshop in Poland, following DUMSKAYA DESIGN drawings and specifications. For projects in Slovakia, Austria, and Germany, we make the furniture at our own workshop in Bratislava.

items.q: Who takes the measurements and does the installation?
items.a: Our partners in Warsaw — the same specialists who installed the furniture on our projects in Poland.

items.q: What currency is the quote in?
items.a: The cost of furniture, delivery, and installation in Warsaw is quoted in Polish złoty — as one total. The interior design project, if you need one, is priced in euros according to the studio's uniform price list.

items.q: Can I order a kitchen from the catalog?
items.a: Yes. We adapt any of the 32 models to the dimensions of your kitchen, your appliances, and your budget, and manufacture it in Poland.

blocks.title: Get a furniture quote
blocks.text: Send us a floor plan or the dimensions of the room and photos — we will prepare a preliminary proposal.
